svg.title: Kubernetes Pod Creation to Running Flow

g.text: For each init container, in order:
pull its image, then run it
Grey dashed chips: what kubectl get pod
STATUS and the conditions show at that step.
Accepted, not running yet: scheduling, image pull (phase Pending)
Scheduled; volumes, sandbox and network being set up (container Waiting)
N of M init containers have finished (phase Pending)
Init containers done; main containers are starting (phase Pending)
An init container image cannot be pulled
An init container exited non-zero or keeps failing
A main container image cannot be pulled (phase Pending)
At least one container is running (phase Running); READY shows ready/total
A container keeps crashing; restart delay doubles up to 5 min (Waiting)
A container exited non-zero and is not restarted (phase Failed)
Killed for exceeding memory (Terminated reason) / evicted by the node (Failed)
Deletion in progress: preStop, SIGTERM, grace period (phase unchanged)
Node cannot be reached, state not known
Container states: Waiting (with a reason such as ContainerCreating, PodInitializing, CrashLoopBackOff), Running, Terminated (exit code and reason).
Pod conditions: PodScheduled, Initialized, ContainersReady, Ready. Pod phases: Pending, Running, Succeeded, Failed, Unknown.
Dashed line: the container is restarted per restartPolicy and the probe starts again. Each image is pulled just before its container starts.
